## Summary

Describe the problem, solution and user-visible changes. Link related non-security issues.
For vulnerabilities, use the private reporting route in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Verification

List commands and results. Separate passed, failed and skipped checks.
Explain any WSL or physical-device requirements and what remains unverified.

## Impact

Describe documentation changes, compatibility, privacy/security implications and
any changes to hook configuration, IPC, startup, USB output or release behavior.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests pass; behavioral changes have a regression test.
- [ ] English and Ukrainian documentation is updated, or documentation impact is explained.
- [ ] I reviewed privacy impact and did not add unnecessary data collection.
- [ ] I reviewed security impact, including input bounds, hook Trust and foreign-hook preservation.
- [ ] I declared hardware tests as run or skipped, with device details when relevant.
- [ ] Formatting and repository-contract checks pass.
- [ ] No generated binaries, local tools or private diagnostics are committed.

Do not attach prompts, responses, transcripts, certificate material, credentials or secrets.
